annotation.title_clean: 国务院办公厅关于加快推进政务服务“跨省通办”的指导意见
annotation.title_en: Guiding Opinions of the General Office of the State Council on Accelerating the "Cross-Province Handling" of Government Services
annotation.authors_or_issuer: 国务院办公厅 (General Office of the State Council of China)
annotation.summary_en: Chinese State Council General Office guideline (Guobanfa [2020] No. 35) on accelerating cross-province handling of government services, setting targets, service models, data-sharing and platform support, and a 140-item list of services. It is not about AI or robotics beyond a passing mention of big data and AI as tools.
key_provisions_or_claims: First batch of services handled cross-province by end-2020; high-frequency items by end-2021
Three models: full online handling, remote receipt and agency handling, multi-location joint handling
National integrated government service platform to host a cross-province portal and e-licence mutual recognition
Establish data-sharing coordination mechanism while protecting state secrets, trade secrets and privacy
Annex lists 140 high-frequency services with lead agencies and deadlines
